format: html

  echo: true

---

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 2: Critical appraisal of the included evidence
#
# Input:
#   output/tables/Chapter4_Analysis_Tables.xlsx
#   sheet: 13_Figure2_EBL_Domains
# Output:
#   output/figures/Figure_2_EBL_Critical_Appraisal.png
# ============================================================

required_packages <- c(
  "here", "readxl", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "patchwork"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Install the required packages before running this script: ",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

library(here)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Relative input and output paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

source_file <- here(
  "output",
  "tables",
  "Chapter4_Analysis_Tables.xlsx"
)

figure_dir <- here("output", "figures")

dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(source_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Input file not found: ", source_file,
      "\nRun 01_chapter4_analysis.qmd before generating Figure 2."
    )
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read the final EBL domain summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

domain_raw <- read_excel(
  path = source_file,
  sheet = "13_Figure2_EBL_Domains"
)

required_columns <- c(
  "Domain", "N", "Mean_pct", "Median_pct", "SD",
  "Meets_75_n", "Meets_75_pct"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(domain_raw))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Required Figure 2 columns are missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

domain_levels <- c(
  "A. Population / Sample",
  "B. Data Collection",
  "C. Study Design",
  "D. Results",
  "Overall"
)

if (
  !setequal(as.character(domain_raw$Domain), domain_levels) ||
    anyDuplicated(as.character(domain_raw$Domain)) > 0
) {
  stop("Figure 2 domain rows do not match the EBL domain specification.")
}

domain_summary <- domain_raw |>
  mutate(
    Domain = factor(
      Domain,
      levels = domain_levels
    ),
    Mean = as.numeric(Mean_pct),
    Median = as.numeric(Median_pct)
  ) |>
  arrange(Domain) |>
  mutate(
    Mean_label = sprintf("Mean %.1f%%", Mean),
    Detail_label = sprintf(
      "Median %.1f%%  |  SD %.1f  |  n=%d",
      Median,
      SD,
      N
    ),
    Threshold_label = sprintf(
      "%d/%d (%.1f%%)",
      Meets_75_n,
      N,
      Meets_75_pct
    )
  )

panel_b_limit <- 100

print(domain_summary)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Figure settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

blue <- "#2F6F9F"
dark_blue <- "#163A59"
light_blue <- "#DCEAF4"
orange <- "#D97706"
grid_colour <- "#D9E1E8"

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans", base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      colour = grid_colour,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "#111111", size = 10.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "#445A6F"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13,
      colour = "#111111"
    ),
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Panel A: domain score profile
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_a <- ggplot(domain_summary, aes(y = Domain)) +
  geom_col(
    aes(x = Mean),
    width = 0.58,
    fill = light_blue,
    colour = blue,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = pmax(Mean - SD, 0),
      xmax = pmin(Mean + SD, 100),
      x = Mean
    ),
    width = 0.13,
    colour = dark_blue,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = Median, colour = "Median"),
    shape = 18,
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 75,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "#B45309",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 76,
    y = 5.45,
    label = "75% threshold",
    hjust = 0,
    colour = "#92400E",
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 2, label = Mean_label),
    hjust = 0,
    colour = "#102A43",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 106, label = Detail_label),
    hjust = 0,
    colour = "#334E68",
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Median = orange)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 155),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(domain_summary$Domain))) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Domain validity scores",
    x = "Validity score (%)"
  ) +
  base_theme

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Panel B: studies meeting the 75% threshold
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_b <- ggplot(domain_summary, aes(y = Domain)) +
  geom_col(
    aes(x = Meets_75_pct),
    width = 0.58,
    fill = blue
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = if_else(
        Meets_75_pct >= 80,
        Meets_75_pct - 1.8,
        Meets_75_pct + 1.8
      ),
      label = Threshold_label,
      hjust = if_else(Meets_75_pct >= 80, 1, 0),
      colour = Meets_75_pct >= 80
    ),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = "white",
      "FALSE" = dark_blue
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, panel_b_limit),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = rev(levels(domain_summary$Domain)),
    labels = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Studies meeting the 75% threshold",
    x = "Studies meeting threshold (%)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Combine and export
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_figure <- plot_a + plot_b +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.35, 1), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste0(
      "Critical appraisal of the included evidence ",
      "using the EBL checklist"
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "sans",
        face = "bold",
        size = 16,
        colour = "#102A43",
        hjust = 0
      )
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "Figure_2_EBL_Critical_Appraisal.png"
  ),
  plot = final_figure,
  width = 15.2,
  height = 5.8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Figure 2 saved to: ", figure_dir)
```
